defs.meaning: 次级离子质谱分析法（secondary ion mass spectroscopy）

examples.en: Jules Sims would also record vocal calypsos.
examples.zh: 朱尔斯·西姆斯还会录制声乐加里波舞。

examples.en: Sims was asleep when he got the call from Stockholm.
examples.zh: 当接到斯德哥尔摩的来电时，西姆斯正在睡觉。

examples.en: "The whole periodic table is churning in there," Sims said.
examples.zh: “周期表的所有元素都存在于这锅熔岩汤中，”西姆斯说。
